name: arrangement-sonnet
judge_note: This profile regroups the speech by theme on purpose: paragraphs are reordered and sentences said in different places are gathered under the theme they belong to. A change of order or grouping is never a finding. An idea the speaker restated in other words may appear once, as long as everything its restatements added survives: a vanished restatement that added nothing is not an omission. Judge only whether the content, the terms, the direction of each statement and the hedges survived the regrouping.
